preconditions.description: The length of the string S must be between 1 and 100,000 characters.
The integer K must be between 1 and 10,000.

preconditions.expression: all(c.isalnum() or c == '-' for c in S)
preconditions.description: The string S must consist only of alphanumeric characters and dashes.

postconditions.description: The output string must contain all characters from S converted to uppercase, with dashes removed.
The length of the output string must equal the length of S after removing dashes.

postconditions.expression: all(len(group) == K for group in stdout.split('-')[1:]) and len(stdout.split('-')[0]) >= 1
postconditions.description: All groups in the output string, except possibly the first, must have exactly K characters, and the first group must have at least one character.
